title: SN TOOL - Official Release v2.0.7 (1080p Muxed Video Fix & Upgraded OTA Engine)
subtitle: Upgraded 1080p Drama Downloader & 1080p+ HLS Preview, automatic scratch disk cleaner, and hardened SHA-256 OTA updater.
release_notes:
• 🎬 1080p Muxed Video+Audio Guarantee: Eliminates audio-only YouTube HLS downloads (itag=233) and renders crisp 1080p+ HLS video+audio in the in-app Preview player.
• 🛡️ FFmpeg Video-Stream Verification: Verifies every episode and full drama file actually contains a valid video stream before marking Completed 100%.
• 🧹 Automatic Disk Cleanup (disk_cleaner.py): Automatically removes temporary WAV/voice scratch files after dubbing so Drive D/C never fills up.
• 🚀 Upgraded In-App OTA Updater: Fixed /api/update/ping restart sync (eliminating 96% stall), added SHA-256 archive verification & Zip-Slip protection.
• 🔑 Full User Credential Preservation: Preserves both license.key and user AI provider API keys automatically during upgrades.
